text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: org 'delta-runway' exceeding org-level RL (5xxs rising). Paging oncall.
oncall-sre: taking it — will triage. Can someone drop recent deploys/changes?
alice.kim: no deploys from infra team in the last hour.
ben.patel: we saw a spike in POST /v1/complete for org-delta-123 starting ~12:02 UTC, 95th latency up, 429s climbing.
cara-ops: Confirming customer-facing errors: CS flagged customers seeing "Quota exceeded" on streaming endpoints.
jane-csm: Delta runway reporting major degradation on staging and prod, users hit at 12:05. They're standing by.
oncall-sre: grabbing RL controls. Plan: short-term emergency bump for org-delta-123, disable noncritical streaming features for that org, and enable backlog shaping. Monitoring.
omar-platform: granting quick path: run `rlctl` to apply override.
oncall-sre: running command now:
```
rlctl override set --org org-delta-123 --rate 200rps --burst 400 --duration 10m --reason "emergency spike" --by oncall-sre
```
metrics-bot: override applied at 1765554350, new rate 200rps (burst 400).
ben.patel: confirming with logs — 429 rate errors dropped by 80% within 90s. Latency normalizing.
alice.kim: also disabling nonessential background streaming for that org to reduce KV pressure: `feature-ctl toggle --org org-delta-123 --feature realtime-preview --off`
cara-ops: Customer notified via CSM: brief update posted, escalated to engineering for root cause. :white_check_mark:
oncall-sre: keeping override until load subsides. If traffic persists after 10m, we'll extend in 15m increments and open a rate adjustment ticket with product to consider permanent quota increase.
jane-csm: Delta runway asks for ETA to full recovery. Can we give 30-45m?
oncall-sre: tentative 30m. We'll update at 12:30 UTC.
omar-platform: added a temporary traffic-shaper rule to cap concurrent streams per user to 4 for that org.
metrics-bot: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/graph?org=delta-runway (visible to incident team). Error rate back to baseline at 1765554398.
oncall-sre: rolling back the noncritical feature toggle only after monitoring 5m of stable metrics.
ben.patel: recording post-action: increased org limit + feature disable + shaper. Creating incident runbook entry.
cara-ops: reminders — open follow-up RFC for quota policy if this becomes recurring.
oncall-sre: handoff to overnight oncall in 40m. If anyone wants to join the handoff doc, ping me. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT: mitigation applied (override id override-1765554350). Severity: high -> monitoring.
